prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck strain after a low-speed head-on collision. The patient had 42 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1028; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a low-speed head-on collision with complaints of neck pain, stiffness, and intermittent headaches radiating from the posterior cervical region. The reported mechanism of injury is consistent with the forces involved in this type of impact, and the presentation reflects a typical cervical strain pattern. Over the course of care, the patient attended 42 visits consisting of manual therapy, supervised range-of-motion exercises, and home stretching instruction. Treatment followed a conventional progression, with visit frequency tapering as symptoms improved and range of motion returned toward baseline. Examination findings included reduced cervical rotation and paraspinal muscle tenderness, which support the diagnosis, while neurological screening, reflexes, and strength testing remained within normal limits. No prior injury to the cervical spine or surrounding soft tissue is known to this provider. Billing records reflect single entries for each service rendered, with no repeated or duplicate charges. Prognosis is good with continued home exercise, and discharge from active care is anticipated.
